title: How Long Until the Watcher Notices? Latency of CoT-Monitoring Inference

original_idea.body: In a toy agentic loop with silently-blocked actions, vary blocking salience and use a CoT classifier to detect the turn the model first verbalizes being monitored, plotting a survival curve of detection latency.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Detection-latency of monitor-awareness bounds the safe CoT-monitoring window, a metric no current paper provides.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Toy agent loop with blocked actions plus CoT classifier; clear inherited methodology, single GPU.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused survival-curve of latency vs salience; few dependencies.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open small reasoning models, lab-independent, fresh metric.

low_compute.reasoning: Small reasoning model on single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Directly extends a 2026 paper with an unmeasured latency metric.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: The detection-latency metric is explicitly noted as unmeasured by the source paper.
